question: In which sentence is the friend doing the action?
answerExplanation: The friend does the arriving in the first sentence, so mi mejor amiga is the subject. In the second, saludo tells us that I do the greeting. Mi mejor amiga is the direct object, introduced by the personal a.

es-mi-det.label: Determiner
es-mi-det.note: Mi tells us whose friend she is.

es-mejor-adj.label: Adjective
es-mejor-adj.note: Mejor means “best” here and comes before amiga in this phrase.

es-amiga-noun.label: Noun
es-amiga-noun.note: Amiga is the main word in the phrase. It names the friend.

es-llegar-verb.label: Verb
es-llegar-verb.note: Llega is the form of llegar used here. It means “arrives.”

es-hoy-adv.label: Adverb
es-hoy-adv.note: Hoy tells us when the friend arrives.

es-saludar-verb.label: Verb
es-saludar-verb.note: Saludo is the form of saludar meaning “I greet.” The verb tells us who is doing the greeting.

es-a-adp.label: Preposition
es-a-adp.note: This is the personal a. It introduces the person being greeted.

tokens.note: The whole phrase mi mejor amiga is the subject. The friend is the one who arrives.
The whole phrase mi mejor amiga is the direct object. The friend is the person I greet.
